items.title: NVIDIA Merlin Vulnerability Allow Attacker to Achieve Remote Code Execution With Root Privileges
items.description: A critical vulnerability in NVIDIA’s Merlin Transformers4Rec library (CVE-2025-23298) enables unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution (RCE) with root privileges via unsafe deserialization in the model checkpoint loader.
